fields.name: item_num
fields.coerce: none: used as an array key
fields.description: The slot of the item to upgrade.

fields.name: scroll_num
fields.coerce: none: used as an array key
fields.description: The slot of a `uscroll` (level + 1) or a `pscroll` (a stat). Required when there is no `offering_num`.

fields.name: offering_num
fields.coerce: none: used as an array key
fields.description: The slot of an offering: an item of type `offering`, or an item with an `offering` property (an ingot or a nugget, only for an item at level 0).

fields.name: clevel
fields.coerce: compared with `!=` to `item.level || 0`, so `"7"` also matches 7
fields.description: The level of the item now. If it does not match, the upgrade fails. This stops a second upgrade on a slot that changed.

fields.name: calculate
fields.description: Selects the variant. If truthy, the server only sends the chance after the checks. It consumes nothing and starts no timer.

failures.intro: **Server bug:** most failures send a bare string, not an object. The handler runs inside `try`; an error sends `exception`. The checks are the same for both variants; `calculate` matters only after the last check.

rows.when: No character. The handler reads `player.items` before it checks `player`, and the error goes to the `catch`.

confirm.note: A TypeError on `player.items`, which the `catch` turns into `exception`

rows.when: The character is in the bank.
You are not on `main`, or you are more than `B.sell_dist` (400 px) from the upgrade NPC. A character with a `computer` passes this check.
The offering is not of type `offering`, and it is not an item with an `offering` property on an item at level 0.
There is no scroll and no offering.
`clevel` is not the level of the item.
A `uscroll` on an item at grade 4.

confirm.note: Every `uscroll` has a grade below 4, so the first of the two returns sends it

rows.when: The scroll is not a `uscroll` or a `pscroll`; or a `pscroll` on an item without `stat`; or the item grade is above the grade of the `uscroll`.
No scroll, and the `offering` value of the ingot or nugget is below the base grade of the item.
A `uscroll`, and the item is locked (`l`).

extra.name: h
extra.description: The scrolls you have in that slot.

rows.when: Any other error in the handler.

list.name: Calculate
list.when: Only computes the chance of success. The server consumes nothing and starts no timer.

confirm.note: Each branch tests `data.calculate` as true or false after its last check

fields.name: response
fields.description: The code.

fields.name: place
fields.description: The request.

fields.name: success
fields.description: Always `true`.

fields.name: calculate
fields.description: Always `true`.

fields.name: chance
fields.description: The chance of success, 0 to 1. A `pscroll` gives 0.99999; a grace offering without a scroll gives 1.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The item.

fields.name: grace
fields.description: The grace of the item now (`item.grace || 0`). `ItemInstance` does not carry grace.

fields.name: scroll
fields.description: The scroll, when the request has one.

fields.name: offering
fields.description: The offering, when the request has one.

list.name: Upgrade
list.when: Consumes the scroll and the offering and starts the upgrade timer.

fields.name: calculate
fields.description: Falsy or absent.

responses.name: Started
responses.when: All checks pass. There is no `game_response` now.
responses.summary: Your state with `reopen: true`. The server removed the scroll and the offering. `items[item_num]` is a `PlaceholderItem`, and `q.upgrade` is a `QueueEntry` that holds the timer.

responses.name: Progress
responses.when: During the timer, each time the server shows one more digit of the roll, and once near the end with `p.success` or `p.failure`. Up to 5 times.

fields.name: q
fields.description: All your timers (`player.q`).

fields.name: num
fields.description: The slot of the placeholder.

fields.name: p
fields.description: The placeholder state, with the digits so far.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: The timer ends and the roll succeeds. The slot gets the item back with its new level (or new `stat_type`, grace, or `p: "shiny"`).

fields.name: response
fields.description: The code.

fields.name: level
fields.description: The old level + 1. **Server bug:** the value is the same for a `pscroll` and a grace offering, which do not change the level.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The slot of the item.

fields.name: stale
fields.description: You left the game during the timer.

fields.name: response
fields.description: The code.

fields.name: stat_type
fields.description: The new stat of the item, from `G.items[scroll].stat`.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The slot of the item.

fields.name: stale
fields.description: You left the game during the timer.

responses.name: Offering success
responses.when: An offering without a scroll added grace to the item.

fields.name: response
fields.description: The code.

fields.name: stale
fields.description: You left the game during the timer.

responses.name: Fail
responses.when: The timer ends and the roll fails. The item is gone, and the slot is `null`. Exceptions: a failed shiny attempt or a failure with `scroll4` (grade 3.6) puts the item back unchanged.

fields.name: response
fields.description: The code.

fields.name: level
fields.description: The level that the upgrade tried: old level + 1.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The slot of the item.

fields.name: stale
fields.description: You left the game during the timer.

also.when: The timer ends. Every client whose view holds the upgrade NPC on `main`.

fields.name: type
fields.description: The kind of result.

fields.name: success
fields.description: 1 for a success, 0 for a failure.

also.when: The timer of a `uscroll` upgrade ends and the item is worth more than 4,800,000 gold, unless you are `stealth`. Not for a shiny attempt, a `pscroll` or a grace offering.
also.summary: An `ItemAnnouncement` (a `LocalizedText` that names you and the item) with `type` `"server_usuccess"` or `"server_ufail"`.

also.when: The timer ends. It carries the result codes above as `hitchhikers`, with `reopen: true`.
also.summary: Your state with the result item (or `null`) in the slot.

order: now: `player` (placeholder in the slot, `q.upgrade` set) to you
during the timer: `q_data` to you, up to 5 times
at the end: `upgrade` to clients near the NPC, and `server_message` to everyone for an expensive item
then `player` to you. Its `hitchhikers` hold `upgrade_offering_success` or `upgrade_success_stat` (if any), then `upgrade_success` or `upgrade_fail`
